name: get_profile
description: The person's goal, age, height, calorie, protein, fat and water targets, who set them (onboarding, div or person) and the calories before, calorie floor, whether protein is set by their doctor, and what Div remembers about them.

name: get_plan
description: The current training plan: each session with its weekday and exercises (sets, rep range, working load in kg).

name: get_training_log
description: Workouts set by set (load kg, reps, reps in reserve) with each exercise's best estimated 1RM per session, newest first.

days.description: How many days back from today. Default 28.

exercise.description: Only this exercise (case-insensitive). Omit for all.

name: get_food_log
description: Meals between two dates with each day's totals (kcal, protein, carbs, fat) and whether the day was logged completely.

name: get_weight_trend
description: Weigh-ins with the smoothed trend weight, the weekly rate of change of the trend, and waist measurements.

days.description: How many days back from today. Default 28.

name: get_div_log
description: Changes Div made, newest first: what changed, which job made it, the reason, and whether it is applied, waiting for approval, or undone.

days.description: How many days back from today. Default 30.
